title: Datenschutzhinweis in Deutsch und Englisch
description: As a user, I want a clear privacy notice in my language, so that I know what happens with my data.

acceptance_criteria.when: a user opens the privacy notice
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with the notice in German and in English including purpose, legal basis, retention periods and rights
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-030-privacy-notice.feature: The notice is reachable in both languages

acceptance_criteria.given: the notice text has been changed in a new release
acceptance_criteria.then: the API returns the current version and the version identifier is exposed
and: the previous version is archived for proof
